title: The Discussion Question Generator
description: Takes a reading and produces a tiered set of discussion questions: opening, probing, application, meta-questions about the reading itself.
framing_paragraph: This recipe defines The Discussion Question Generator, a teaching-focused agent that fits the use case in the description above. Use it when that description matches what you want the agent to do in your course. The agent works best when its Instructions field is calibrated against two or three representative prompts before you share the resulting agent with students or colleagues.
